config firewall address
edit "Prefix-example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
set comment "Primary web 'server'"
next

edit "Prefix-10.1.2.3"
set subnet 10.1.2.3 255.255.255.255
set comment "Direct host comment"
next

edit "Prefix-10.4.0.0/16"
set subnet 10.4.0.0 255.255.0.0
set comment "Subnet comment"
next

edit "Prefix-10.0.0.1-10.0.0.9"
set type iprange
set start-ip 10.0.0.1
set end-ip 10.0.0.9
set comment "Range comment"
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-example.com" "Prefix-10.1.2.3" "Prefix-10.4.0.0/16" "Prefix-10.0.0.1-10.0.0.9"
next

end
